utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you decided what needs fixing for the repair drive, or should we make a list together?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s make a list together — I’ve got a couple things in mind already.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what’s first on your list?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I might need to look around first, since I’m a bit scattered today.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — take your time and see what you need. I’ll have the tools ready whenever you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I’m just trying to make sure the timing and pickup details don’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll ask around and see if anyone knows the timing or pickup plan. If I hear anything, I’ll tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you help at the community shed on Maple Street and check the boxes of donated tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can head to the community shed on Maple Street and check the donated tool boxes. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive today. If you want, I can also invite a few more neighbors I know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. That would really help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start reaching out right away and tell a few folks I know. We’ll get more hands on deck for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’m organizing the repair drive now and I’ll keep it simple for everyone. If you want, I can share the list of needed supplies or help assign a few blocks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Share the needed supplies, and I can help assign a few blocks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — we need gloves, duct tape, zip ties, trash bags, brooms, and a few basic tool kits. I’ll send you the block list next so you can start assigning folks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes to anything, can you remind me what needs fixing and when the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m sorry, I don’t have the details yet — I just heard about the repair drive. If you want, I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would help, thanks — please check the details and let me know when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times, so let me know what the repair drive needs and I’ll see what works.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Faye — thank you. I’ll send over the repair drive needs and the pickup/drop-off windows so we can match them up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, send it over when you can and I’ll map it against school times. I’ll do my best to help make the pickups and drop-offs work smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I’m still piecing it together, but I can pass along what I hear and help keep folks updated.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in—just send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you want the repair drive details sent over now, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, send them over now and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you tell me what still needs fixing for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I’m a bit scatterbrained, but I know we still need to sort the loose wiring and that stubborn gate. I’ll check my notes and get right back to you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, just let me know what your notes say and I’ll take care of my part.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll keep reminding folks and repeat the plan as needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be a big help, Vik — thank you. I’ll keep the supply list updated so we know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan and reminding folks what’s still needed. Thanks for keeping the supply list up to date.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll check in around town and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to mention that. Let me know what you need from me, and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’m planning to sort the drop-off table and label the repair bins. If you can help greet people when they arrive, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I can do that. Just point me to the table, and I’ll greet folks as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I think I heard something about it, but I might’ve missed the details. What’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s just a neighborhood repair drive—bring any small items that need fixing, and we’ll sort them by priority. I can send you the time and place if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, send me the time and place — I’d like to come by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll make a short list of tools, and you can tell me what you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — send me the list, and I’ll tell you what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Mara—could you help greet people and point them to the signup table? I’ll make sure you get the details and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with folks on Maple and Pine—especially anyone who’s mentioned broken lamps or loose steps. I can jot down a short list for you if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes please—that’d help a lot. I’ll start with Maple and Pine and check in on the lamps and loose steps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m glad you’re here. I’m pulling the repair drive list together now, so tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’d start with the leaky faucet and the broken porch light — those seem most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll put the leaky faucet and porch light at the top of the list. Thanks, Cleo; that really helps me sort the drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet — what’s still on the list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m mostly hearing they still need tools and a few volunteers, but I’m not sure of the exact list. If you know, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the basics and where to drop it off — I’ll skim the details once you send them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Kira. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still willing to help with the repair drive, right?
